info.description:
# Humsafar API - Phase 1

Everything built so far: **Auth, KYC, Linkage, Permissions** (Tasks 1.3 to 1.6).

## Quick start
1. Start the backend: `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` (from `backend/`).
2. Select the **Humsafar Local** environment (`base_url` = http://localhost:8000).
3. Run any folder, or the whole collection, in the **Collection Runner**. Every folder creates its own test accounts, so folders can be run alone and in any order.

## How to read it
Every request has a description (who may call it, body, errors) and a saved **example response** captured from the real running backend. Errors always look like `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`; branch on `error.code`.

## Auth flow
`/auth/register` -> `/auth/login` -> send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. On 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED call `/auth/refresh` once.

Full written contracts: `docs/api/` in the repo (start with `docs/api/README.md`).

request.description:
The Dependent's phone sends one GPS fix.

**Auth:** the Dependent's own token only (a Guardian, or another Dependent, gets 403 FORBIDDEN).
**Body:** `lat`, `lng` (required); optional `recorded_at` (ISO time WITH timezone, default = now), `battery_level` 0-100, `speed_mps`, `accuracy_m`.

exec: pm.test('first fix = moving, short interval', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.movement_state).to.eql('moving'); pm.expect(b.next_update_interval_s).to.eql(10); pm.expect(b.duplicate).to.eql(false); });
